column1: # The names and four-letter keys of the accounts and environments: the single source of truth.
# name   explanatory: account name, live/environments/<name> stack, GitHub Environment, APP_ENV, docs.
# kind   account | environment. Only environments have a live/environments/<name> stack.
# key    exactly four lowercase letters (^[a-z]{4}$) and unique. Used in the naming conventions of
#        AWS resources (role names, policy and resource name patterns) so that they can be checked
#        with strict regexps. A key is not a name: it is never accepted where a name is expected.
# Fields are separated by a tab. scripts/ci-stacks.sh validates this file on every run and the
# selftest (scripts/test-tooling.sh) proves that a bad key or a duplicate is refused.
